Corollary
[Length under Ricci flow] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0261 1. Corollary 8.24\group dilations-of-infinite-time-singularities

If $\gamma _t$ is a time-dependent family of curves with fixed endpoints in a Ricci flow solution, and if each $\gamma _t$ is either independent of time or geodesic with respect to $g(t)$, then \[ \frac{d}{dt}L_t(\gamma _t)=-\int _{\gamma _t}\Rc (S,S)\, ds. \]

Proof

Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0261 \sketch The general length variation formula gives

\[ \frac{d}{dt}L_t(\gamma _t) = -\int _{\gamma _t}\Rc (S,S)\, ds - \int _{\gamma _t}\langle \nabla _S S,V\rangle \, ds. \]

If $\gamma _t$ is time-independent or geodesic with respect to $g(t)$, then the second integral vanishes. The displayed formula follows.

□
